subject: Error deploying to Shinyapps.io: Maximum supported version of R is 3.2.2?

messages.author: c54f63fc91a1b09d
messages.subject: Error deploying to Shinyapps.io: Maximum supported version of R is 3.2.2?
parts:
Hi,

I'm running RStudio from the most recent rocker/ropensci Docker image (https://hub.docker.com/r/rocker/ropensci/).

I threw together a Shiny app that runs just fine inside the docker container, but gives me the following error when I try to deploy it to shinyapps.io:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 73266...DONE
Deploying bundle: 329748 for application: 73266 ...
Waiting for task: 114951222
  error: Parsing manifest
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 114951223 failed: Error parsing manifest: Maximum supported R version is: 3.2.2
Execution halted
The Docker container is running R 3.2.3. This is the first time I've seen this error. Does anyone have a workaround until things at shinyapps.io get updated?
